source_summary: Wide Chinese landscape handscroll with rocky mountains at left, a lakeside scholar studio in the lower left, old pines and bamboo in the foreground, soft distant hills over water, willows and rocky banks at right, and a small diagonal bridge at the lower right. Inscriptions, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: misty_layered_mountain_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the large left-background mountain mass: rounded overlapping cliffs and hillsides rising behind the garden, with mist at the base. Exclude red seals and any foreground trees or pavilion elements crossing the lower edge.
must_preserve: rounded contour linework of the mountain ridges
pale green-gray and ochre washes on the rock faces
dense dark moss-dot texture along ridge crests and seams
soft misty lower edge where the mountain dissolves behind the foreground
fine internal striation lines showing layered rock volume

motifs.name: soft_distant_hill_band
motifs.description: Isolate the pale central distant hill silhouette across the water: a low hazy mountain form with gentle peaks and a faint horizontal shoreline/mist band beneath it. Exclude nearby calligraphy and red seals.
must_preserve: soft-edged gray-green wash with almost no hard outline
subtle peak profile and flattened base
faint atmospheric layering that suggests water and haze
delicate tonal gradation fading into the paper-colored sky

motifs.name: riverside_studio_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left studio/pavilion group: tiled roofs, pale walls, vertical wooden posts, open book shelves, round moon window, and low platform. Exclude surrounding tree trunks, pine foliage, shrubs, and foreground rocks where separable.
must_preserve: repeating curved roof-tile linework
crisp roof geometry with eaves and gable details
vertical timber frame lines and pale wall wash
visible books and shelves inside the open window
round moon window with interior table and books
thin ink outlines and restrained tan color accents

motifs.name: central_old_pine_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant foreground old pines in the center: twisting pale trunks, branching limbs, and dense needle clusters spreading horizontally over the pavilion and garden. Exclude pavilion architecture and bamboo where separable.
must_preserve: gnarled pale trunks with dark knot marks and bark spots
sinuous branch structure with exposed tan wash
radiating fine pine-needle strokes forming rounded clusters
dark ink accents at branch joints and trunk scars
overlapping foliage masses with varied needle density
root bases and lower trunk texture at the garden edge

motifs.name: right_bamboo_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the bamboo thicket behind and to the right of the pines: multiple thin culms, angled leafy sprays, and darker clustered leaves descending toward the shore. Exclude pine trunks and distant hill wash where separable.
must_preserve: slender segmented bamboo culm lines
arched leaf clusters painted with quick tapered strokes
dark dense lower bamboo foliage
lighter upper sprays fading into the air
overlapping layers that create a screen behind the pines
subtle green-gray wash accents around the leaves

motifs.name: left_willow_plum_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the left garden trees beside the pavilion: drooping willow branches, dark leafy shrub forms, and pale blossoming plum branches near the roof. Exclude red seals above and the pavilion roof where separable.
must_preserve: long drooping willow frond linework
dark twisting trunks and branch forks
fine pale blossom branches with pink-white accents
dense dark shrub texture at the lower left
soft green washes around the willow foliage
delicate contrast between bare blossom twigs and hanging leaves

motifs.name: right_willow_rocky_islet
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side willow and rocky bank: a compact cluster of drooping willows, pale flowering branches, and rounded rocks at the edge of the water. Exclude nearby red seals and empty water beyond the immediate bank.
motifs.role: right foreground shoreline trees and rocks
must_preserve: weeping willow leaves drawn as fine trailing strokes
gnarled dark trunks and exposed branch structure
small pale pink-white blossom accents on lower branches
rounded rock forms with moss-dot edges
green-gray wash on the bank and foliage
soft water-facing edge of the islet

motifs.name: diagonal_wooden_bridge_shoreline
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right diagonal wooden footbridge crossing the water near the shore, including its rail posts, planks, small stones in the water, and adjacent sloped banks. Exclude the right willow cluster and unrelated foreground rocks.
must_preserve: thin diagonal bridge plank lines
upright dark railing posts and supports
small scattered stepping stones or rocks in the water
pale water wash around the bridge
curved green shoreline with dotted vegetation texture
ink-dark bank outlines and subtle ochre rock accents

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
